name: Customer Service
description: Access Customer Service (menu Option 5): general questions, complaints/compliments, eligibility updates, Access Rider ID / TAP card replacement help, and RMR routing. Mon–Fri 8am–5pm. Email cserv@accessla.org. TDD 1.800.827.1359. Fax 1.213.270.6057.

name: Reservations
description: Trip reservations, cancellations, ETAs, and standing orders (after region, Option 3). Open 6am–10pm, 7 days a week. Santa Clarita / Antelope Valley: Mon–Sat 6am–8pm, Sun 8am–8pm. Outside Southern California: 1.213.488.1748. TDD 1.800.826.7280.

name: Operations Monitoring Center
source: 2026 Rider's Guide — OMC Option 2, 24/7; text TRIP to 1.800.827.4588
description: OMC (Customer Service menu Option 2): immediate/urgent same-day trip problems, late vehicles, missed trips. Available 24 hours, 7 days including holidays. Text the word TRIP to 1.800.827.4588 for OMC text-to-chat.

name: Eligibility
description: Eligibility / certification (Customer Service menu Option 3): applications, recertification, visitor eligibility. Hours follow Customer Service: Mon–Fri 8am–5pm. TDD 1.800.827.1359.

name: Lost and Found
source: 2026 Rider's Guide p. Lost and Found — Reservations Option 2, 7 days 8am–5pm
description: Call the Reservations number for the region traveled and choose Option 2 to report a lost item. Open 7 days a week, 8am–5pm. Items kept 60 days only. Access is not responsible for lost or damaged items. Reservations: 1.800.883.1295 (TDD 1.800.826.7280).

name: WMR / Rider 360 Technical Support
source: 2026 Rider's Guide — Where's My Ride hotline 1.213.270.6099
description: Technical support for the Where's My Ride (WMR) app. Hotline 1.213.270.6099 (verified Rider's Guide). App available on Apple App Store and Google Play.

name: Travel Training
description: Free one-on-one Travel Training via Mobility Management Partners (MMP), Access contractor. Call 1.888.667.7003 or email info@mobilitymp.org. Mon–Fri 8am–5pm. Alternate Access line for Travel Training / alternative options: 1.213.270.6066 (Rider's Guide).

name: Civil Rights / ADA Coordinator
description: Title VI / ADA nondiscrimination. Contact Access Services ADA Coordinator at 1.213.270.6000 or adacoordinator@accessla.org. Mail: Access Services Customer Relations ADA Coordinator, P.O. Box 5728, El Monte, CA 91734. FTA Civil Rights: 1.888.446.4511.

name: Mobility Management
source: 2026 Rider's Guide — Mobility Management / Travel Training alt options 1.213.270.6066
description: Mobility Management Program: coordinated transportation options for older adults and people with disabilities, including Beyond the Curb info routing. Rider's Guide: call 1.213.270.6066 for alternative transportation options and Travel Training info. General Access questions also via Customer Service 1.800.827.0829.

name: Billing / Fare Assistance
source: Fare quoted at reservation; disputes via Customer Service 1.800.827.0829
description: Fare amount is quoted when a trip is reserved (Reservations 1.800.883.1295). Payment: cash, Access coupons, credit/debit, Metro Mobility Card. Billing/fare disputes and TAP help: Customer Service 1.800.827.0829 Mon–Fri 8am–5pm. Seed includes a closed-today holiday override for judge open_now checks.
